name: capsaicin + methyl salicylate
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with strains, sprains, bruises, simple backache, and arthritis. Combined with stretching and calisthenics, Atomic Balm assists in the warm-up process, especially in cool, damp weather. Do not bandage tightly.
otcwarn: Consult a doctor before administering to children, including teenagers, with chicken pox or flu.
